question: Which products send the most people to the ER in 2025?
response:
Based on the 2025 NEISS emergency-department injury records, the products (and general categories/activities) sending the most people to the ER—measured by estimated national injuries (`estimated_injuries`) using CPSC sample weights—are:

1. **Floors or flooring materials** (approx. 2,199,378 estimated injuries / 47,267 reported cases)
2. **Stairs or steps (excluding pull-down and folding stairs)** (approx. 1,228,377 estimated injuries / 29,531 reported cases)
3. **Beds or bedframes, other or not specified** (approx. 999,656 estimated injuries / 25,989 reported cases)
4. **Chairs, other or not specified** (approx. 433,183 estimated injuries / 10,818 reported cases)
5. **Bicycles or accessories (excluding mountain or all-terrain bicycles)** (approx. 412,756 estimated injuries / 10,456 reported cases)
6. **Bathtubs or showers** (approx. 369,916 estimated injuries / 8,647 reported cases)
7. **Exercise (activity or apparel without equipment)** (approx. 361,889 estimated injuries / 8,476 reported cases)
8. **Basketball (activity, apparel or equipment)** (approx. 358,220 estimated injuries / 10,306 reported cases)
9. **Knives, not elsewhere classified** (approx. 342,503 estimated injuries / 7,034 reported cases)
10. **Football (activity, apparel or equipment)** (approx. 307,911 estimated injuries / 9,754 reported cases)

tool_calls.name: run_sql

args.query:
SELECT 
    p.title AS product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS er_visits
FROM neiss n
JOIN product_codes p ON n.product_code = p.code
WHERE n.year = 2025
GROUP BY p.title
ORDER BY er_visits DESC
LIMIT 10;

args.query:
SELECT 
    p.title AS product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS er_visits,
    SUM(n.Weight) AS estimated_injuries
FROM neiss n
JOIN product_codes p ON CAST(n.Product_1 AS VARCHAR) = CAST(p.code AS VARCHAR)
WHERE n.Treatment_Date >= '2025-01-01' AND n.Treatment_Date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.title
ORDER BY estimated_injuries DESC
LIMIT 10;

args.query:
SELECT 
    p.product_title AS product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS reported_cases,
    SUM(n.Weight) AS estimated_injuries
FROM neiss n
JOIN product_codes p ON n.Product_1 = p.product_code
WHERE n.Treatment_Date >= '2025-01-01' AND n.Treatment_Date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_title
ORDER BY estimated_injuries DESC
LIMIT 10;
